evidence: Annotates CBlockIndex fields in src/chain.h with GUARDED_BY(cs_main) and fixes racy reads in validation and snapshot paths.
rationale: It fixes confirmed data races on CBlockIndex::nTx and m_chain_tx_count during background validation and block processing. Resolving data races identified under ThreadSanitizer improves chainstate concurrency safety, though the issue does not threaten consensus validity or cause crashes.
